statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the WATCH band.
recommendation: ISM Services beat with orderly post-print structure keeps Tail low; the Fed Waller speech at 17:30Z is the narrow danger window and Friday's NFP is the next material catalyst. Overall regime tagged EA_ON.
headline: Nasdaq-100 firmer post ISM Services beat (55.4); Fed Waller next, NFP tomorrow.
body: NQ trades near 29,316 (+0.45%) with NDX at 29,299 (+0.54%) in the upper half of its 29,161-29,330 intraday band; VIX 15.03 (-1.1%). ISM Services August printed 55.4 vs 54.3 expected (26th month of expansion), while initial jobless claims came in at 206K vs 205K exp and prior ADP was soft at +38K. 2Y at 4.39% and 10Y at 4.79% (H.15 as of Sep 1) sit near multi-year highs; WTI $92.16 (+1.3%) on Middle East supply concerns keeps ambient Stress. Broadcom -3.1% drags the semi complex while Software leads breadth. No observed persistent one-way structure or shallow-pullback pattern, so Tail stays low despite elevated Stress into Fed Waller (17:30Z) and Friday NFP. Mapped policy state: EA_ON with a narrow danger window around the Fed Waller headline burst.
